subject: Post-call: POC acceptance criteria & trial action items for Clearmind
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Gopal <amit.gopal@clearmind.ai>; Priya Kapoor <priya.k@clearmind.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: POC acceptance criteria & trial action items for Clearmind

Hi Amit / Priya — great conversation today. Thanks for walking us through the primary success outcomes. Per our call, I captured a concise acceptance rubric and next steps so we have a single source of truth for the pilot kickoff. High-level acceptance criteria (proposed):

- Latency: P95 inference latency <= 250ms for 1k token context in the US region across 95% of requests during synthetic traffic window.
- Throughput: Sustained 600 QPS (user requests per second) with 95th percentile latency under 350ms during 30-minute stress windows.
- Cost: Host-side unit cost <= $0.0007 / token for the production configuration (batching + quantization profile).
- Quality: Task-specific accuracy (QA recall) >= 92% on the customer-provided evaluation set; hallucination rate < 2% (manual spot checks + automated heuristics).
- Stability: No more than 2 errors/hour at peak load; recovery time from transient failures < 60s with automatic fallback to smaller model variant.

Evaluation plan (2-week trial):
- Week 0 (prep): RW to ingest sample logs, run profile pass, and provide an ops playbook. Clearmind to share 5k anonymized sample queries and evaluation labels (attached: sample-logs).
- Week 1: Synthetic replay at small scale + smoke tests; collect latency and cost baseline; iterate batching settings.
- Week 2: Ramp to target throughput with repeated stress windows and run QA evaluation suite; capture token economics and error telemetry.

Owners:
- Redwood PM (Evelyn) — PO of trial, acceptance signoff.
- Redwood Solutions (Ben) — infra/config, load profiles and batching recommendations.
- Redwood CS (Jordan) — onboarding, ops runbook, and deployment windows.
- Clearmind Eng (Amit) — provide sample logs, labels, and approve test windows.

Next steps (actionable):
1) Clearmind: upload anonymized sample logs + evaluation labels by EOD Friday (2027-07-30).
2) Redwood (Ben): share initial POC config (GPU size, quantization profile, batching knobs) by Monday 2027-08-02.
3) Schedule 30-minute kickoff to confirm test windows; proposed slot Tue 2027-08-03 16:00 ET.

Attachments: I attached the POC template and a network diagram to help procurement and security vetting. If these criteria look right, say “approved” and we’ll lock dates.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Product Manager, Trials & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Amit Gopal <amit.gopal@clearmind.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@clearmind.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 19:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC acceptance criteria & trial action items for Clearmind

Thanks, Evelyn — this is very helpful and aligns with our internal expectations. Quick clarifications:

- The QA recall metric: we’ll provide a 2k labeled set (intent + golden answers). Is the 92% target measured as exact match or fuzzy match? We prefer fuzzy scoring (top-3 pass rate) for our product.
- Cost target looks reasonable; can Redwood provide a short sensitivity table that shows cost per token at 50%/75%/100% load?

We’ll upload the logs and labels by Friday. The Tue 8/3 slot works for Amit and Priya — please send an invite.

— Amit
Amit Gopal
Head of ML Engineering
Clearmind
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: prep for Clearmind ingest & cost sensitivity

Looping in a quick internal checklist before the kickoff: 

- I will run the profile pass against clearmind-sample-logs.json as soon as it lands and produce a configuration matrix (GPU type, batch size, quantization) by EOD Mon (2027-08-02).
- I’ll include a simple cost sensitivity table: cost/token at 50%, 75%, 100% of target throughput, and estimated savings with KV-prefix caching.
- Jordan: can you prepare the ops-runbook stub (incident playbook, rollback, fallback variant) and a readiness checklist for the customer?

Ben

- Ben: share the POC config matrix by EOD today (2027-08-02) — I need it to finalize the ops windows.
- Evelyn: please send the calendar invite for Tue 2027-08-03 16:00 ET and include the test-window doc link.

If all agreed, we’ll start Week 1 smoke tests on Wed 2027-08-04 and target ramp week of 2027-08-09.

Jordan Blake
